stories.title: FCC signs off on SpaceX’s plan to put up to 1 million data center satellites into space
stories.explanation: The FCC has authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million AI chip-equipped satellites for its 'Starmind' initiative, marking the first approval for a full constellation of AI satellites in space. This represents a significant step towards space-based AI infrastructure.

stories.title: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia
stories.explanation: Nvidia has paused server shipments to Southeast Asian countries as the U.S. tightens export controls on AI chips to prevent them from reaching China. This impacts Nvidia's supply chain and highlights ongoing U.S. efforts to control AI technology access.

stories.title: OpenAI says heavy ChatGPT users may hit limits sooner as it merges Chat and Work
stories.explanation: OpenAI is merging ChatGPT's Chat and Work experiences into a single usage meter, which may cause heavy users to hit limits sooner. This change could impact access to advanced models for some subscribers.

stories.title: Building on Nemotron 3.5 Parse: Open Data, Fine-Tuning, and Faster Inference
stories.explanation: NVIDIA released new tools for Nemotron 3.5 Parse, a document model, including synthetic training datasets, a fine-tuning recipe, and a DFlash2 speculator for faster inference. This enhances the model's ability to extract structured data from documents for RAG and agents.

stories.title: How to Optimize NVFP4 Attention on NVIDIA RTX Blackwell Through Register Recycling
stories.explanation: NVIDIA detailed how to optimize NVFP4 Attention on NVIDIA RTX Blackwell GPUs through register recycling, addressing attention bottlenecks in serving foundation models. This aims to accelerate attention beyond BF16 by leveraging hardware-accelerated 4-bit matrix multiplication.

stories.title: Verifiable Social Reasoning for LLM Assistants
stories.explanation: Google Research introduced an evaluation framework for LLM assistants based on multi-agent social simulations to quantify their social reasoning from subjective user narratives. This framework provides verifiable ground truth for assessing how well AI assistants understand social situations.

stories.title: Meta Refused to Share Muse for Testing, UK Financial Watchdog Complains
stories.explanation: Meta declined a request from the UK's financial regulator to joint-test its Muse personal agent before its UK rollout. This highlights regulatory concerns about AI product compliance and Meta's approach to collaboration with watchdogs.

stories.title: 42 state AGs are trying to stop Character.AI from selling users’ chats
stories.explanation: A coalition of 42 state attorneys general is trying to stop Character.AI from selling user chat histories, including those of minors, during its Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings. This raises significant privacy concerns regarding AI companies and user data.

stories.title: Introducing the llama.cpp benchmark dashboard for AMD Ryzen and Radeon
stories.explanation: Hugging Face released a llama.cpp benchmark dashboard for AMD Ryzen and Radeon hardware, allowing developers to track local inference performance across different builds, models, and quantizations. This helps developers inspect how performance changes over time and compare configurations.

stories.title: AI may soon change what it means to be a theoretical physicist
stories.explanation: A theoretical physicist found that a frontier AI model could solve complex physics problems that had not appeared online. This suggests AI is advancing in its ability to tackle novel scientific challenges, potentially changing theoretical physics research.
